projects.name: MedVault
projects.stack: Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Google Gemini API, React, TypeScript, JWT, Docker
bullets: Engineered a structured Google Gemini API prompting pipeline with a hard-coded JSON output schema and explicit safety constraints preventing diagnosis/prescription hallucinations, capping input at 50,000 characters and adding a tolerant JSON-from-prose fallback parser for malformed model output.

Designed a Django REST Framework backend with a custom email-based User model, JWT authentication with refresh-token rotation, and per-user data isolation enforced at the queryset level; isolated all Gemini calls behind a single mockable client so a 47-test backend suite runs with zero API key configured.

projects.name: Canopy
projects.stack: Django, PostgreSQL, tree-sitter, Python ast, Google Gemini API, Plotly Dash, Docker
bullets: Designed a multi-language static-analysis engine unifying Python's ast module and tree-sitter behind one generic analyzer interface, supporting 10 languages with deterministic cross-file call-graph resolution.

Architected an optional AI chat feature fully isolated from the deterministic analysis pipeline — grounded only in already-computed call-graph results, keeping the core parsing product 100% LLM-free with zero hallucination risk — backed by a commit-hash-keyed PostgreSQL cache and least-privilege, zero-scope GitHub OAuth.
